title: Sure! Here's a quick descripion of the three bikes:
subtitle: Ducati
description_it:
Cagiva Mito 125: A lightweight 2-stroke sportbike, famous for its Ducati 916-inspired design. Despite its small 125cc engine, it's known for sharp handling and surprising performance, making it a favorite among young riders and enthusiasts.
Yamaha R3: A 4-stroke, twin-cylinder entry-level supersport with a 321cc engine. It offers a great balance between power and agility, perfect for beginners who want a reliable, stylish, and capable sportbike.
Kawasaki Ninja 500 SE: The next step up from the Ninja 400, featuring a 451cc parallel-twin engine…
